verdict.rationale: Auth0 is an authentication platform, so first-party framework SDKs and route-protecting middleware are a fair axis. However, the evidence pack never documents a Next.js (or peer) SDK, middleware-based route protection, or edge session verification. The only nearby items are a generic pointer to application-type quickstarts (auth0-docs-96), AI-agent framework integrations for Token Vault, and vague praise for its open source packages; none of these evidence this capability.
